//Google: Sign in with Google. ClientIds are the OAuth client ids a Google ID token may be minted for (the Web application client id, which the website and the Android app both request tokens for; the project's Android client ids may be listed after it so a token addressed to one of them is never refused). Empty switches the feature off; supply it as Google__ClientIds__0 in the environment.
//Hangfire: Background job processing with PostgreSQL storage. Enabled by default. Dashboard at /hangfire (Admin only).
//PushNotifications: Push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging. To switch on: set Enabled=true and give the Firebase service account key (Firebase console > Project settings > Service accounts > Generate new private key) EITHER as a file path in FcmServiceAccountPath (developer machine) OR as its content in FcmServiceAccountJson (a server: set the environment variable PushNotifications__FcmServiceAccountJson to the JSON, or to the JSON base64-encoded). Never commit the key. GraceMinutes: how long after its moment a scheduled notification is still sent. HistoryDays: how long the delivery log and each seeker's inbox are kept. DataOnly: leave false unless the app should draw every notification itself. The Notification Console in the app shows whether the key was accepted.
//Alerting: Alerting thresholds for Prometheus/Alertmanager. See PrometheusAlertRules.RulesYaml for alert rules.
